from pathlib import Path
import json, os, platform, subprocess, sys, uuid
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
ROOT=Path.cwd().resolve()
assert (ROOT/'compatible_one_layer.py').is_file(), '请将补丁内容合并到full_model_test'
assert platform.system()=='Linux' and platform.machine().lower() in ('armv7l','armv8l')
RUN=ROOT/'test_results'/('compatible_one_'+uuid.uuid4().hex)
RUN.mkdir(parents=True)
def execute_stage(stage):
    destination=RUN/stage
    destination.mkdir()
    command=[sys.executable,'-B',str(ROOT/'compatible_one_layer.py'),'--stage',stage,'--output',str(destination)]
    if stage=='fpga':
        gate=RUN/'cpu/correctness.json'
        assert gate.is_file() and json.loads(gate.read_text())['pass'], '软件检查未通过，不加载FPGA'
        command+=['--cpu-report',str(gate)]
    try:
        proc=subprocess.run(command,cwd=str(ROOT),text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
            timeout=900,env={**os.environ,'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1'})
        output=proc.stdout
        returncode=proc.returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
        output=error.stdout or ''
        if isinstance(output,bytes):
            output=output.decode('utf-8',errors='replace')
        output+='\n超过900秒，停止并返回日志；若发生硬件超时，请重启板卡后再继续。'
        returncode=-1
    (destination/'execution.log').write_text(output,encoding='utf-8')
    print(output)
    print('返回码:',returncode,'结果目录:',destination)
    assert returncode==0, '本阶段未通过，请返回完整输出，不继续下一格'
print('本次结果目录:',RUN)
execute_stage('cpu')
execute_stage('fpga')
